publication_blockers: F01-01: genuine Burp exporter capture with provenance and a verified DTD-safe Burp import profile remain incomplete. Native ZAP 2.17.0 / reports 0.43.0 and Playwright HAR captures are verified.
Producer remains 1.1.0.dev0. Stable 1.1.0 requires complete acceptance, final-version revalidation and successful CI on the exact reviewed commit.
version_decision: Retain 1.1.0.dev0 until F01-01 closes. Then release 1.1.0. No prior 1.1.x stable release exists here to justify 1.1.5 as a fix release.
remote_ci_status: Not established by this file; inspect the remote workflow on the exact commit before publishing.

verification_depth.standalone: Ed25519 signature, inventory, file hashes, JSON structure and report anchor binding; Python standard library plus OpenSSL.
verification_depth.main: Adds source-bound report, contract, comparison, finding, snapshot, workflow and renderer semantics for the supported profiles.
verification_depth.trust: The public key must be authenticated separately. Neither verifier proves remote execution truth, operator identity or trusted time.

known_limits: Local single-operator workbench; hosted multi-user operation is outside this release.
Three assessment demonstrations use authored synthetic loopback fixtures and do not close genuine Burp exporter acceptance. Native ZAP and Playwright HAR are separately evidenced.
Default oracle evidence is an evaluation attestation; discarded raw response values cannot be independently reconstructed.
Selective retests prove only the explicitly retained rule, identity, object and valid controls; omitted findings remain not_retested.
Only the documented Linux/CPython and Chromium environment is measured; other platforms and full accessibility are not certified.
No independent comparative review, external customer validation or universal standards compliance is claimed.
Local history requires separately retained anchors to resist wholesale replacement.

release_media.note: Historical 1.0 media do not demonstrate the 1.1 assessment workflow and are excluded from this development package.
